label: Sidney Gottlieb
narrative: Sidney Gottlieb is the officer at the centre of the destruction event the board's own MKULTRA hearing node argues from, and three separate opened documents give him three offices in sequence. In March and June 1955 he certifies the invoices of a numbered MKULTRA subproject as Chief of the Chemical Division of the Technical Services Staff, which is the closest thing in the released record to a signature on the money. In 1963 the Agency's Inspector General calls him the present Deputy Chief of the Technical Services Division and credits him with a six-month study of scientific and technical problems in covert action operations. In January 1973 Technical Services Division personnel destroy the MKULTRA files on his verbal order, which he and Richard Helms both later testified was Helms's order carried out. The 1977 Senate hearing that reopened the subject could not produce him: the questioning turns again and again on the fact that the one man who would know was not there.
